answer: Take the smallest option first. Bind each identity to a hardware TEE key and have the node verify a quote before crediting work. When peers disagree on a quote's freshness, dilute that identity's weight instead of banning it, so one bad report does not cascade. Let idle identities bleed standing every epoch, which anchors the cost of parking accounts. The quartz clock inside the enclave signs monotonic counters, so cloning a key without the same silicon fails. A farm must buy real chips: that is the ocean it has to cross.
